mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer and business demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining RSAFS are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals rising supply capacity and potential inflationary pressures, which leads to higher discount rates and lower equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
